Use filter to return payment links matching one or more comparison expressions. Each expression must be in the query string form:
<field><operator><value>
When multiple expressions are provided, results include payment links that satisfy the combined filter criteria.
Field Operators Field/Values
status = and != link_status_active, link_status_paid, link_status_inactive, link_status_expired
order_id = merchantOrderNumber
amount =, !=, >, >=, <, <= totalTransactionAmount
partial_paid = true, false
merchant_portal_username = merchantPortalUsername
An expression which specifies field and order in which Payment Links should be listed.
